description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.desc: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry ran for 58 yards on 17 carries and caught one pass for two yards in the team's 13-10 loss in Cleveland.
items.impact: Henry was held scoreless for the first time this season, ending a five-game streak of rushing/receiving touchdowns that had opened the year. He also lost a fumble in the tight contest. Henry's long-term outlook remains strong, but with Lamar Jackson sidelined, there is a lower floor for his output.
items.title: Derrick Henry gains 60 scoreless yards in Week 6 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 30-of-36 pass attempts for 305 yards and one touchdown while also rushing four times for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Williams was impactful in his return to the lineup for head coach Ben Johnson, surpassing 300 passing yards for the first time in his three contests while battling a hamstring injury. The dual-threat signal-caller remains a dynamic lineup option in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.
items.title: Caleb Williams efficient in Week 6 win over Falcons

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: D'Andre Swift rushed 16 times for 44 yards and two touchdowns while also hauling in four of his five targets for 26 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Swift continues an impactful stretch out of the Chicago backfield, finishing with over 70 offensive yards in each of his six contests. The running back will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.
items.title: D'Andre Swift reaches end zone twice in Week 6 win over Falcons

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Luther Burden III hauled in all eight of his targets for 95 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Burden III has made the most of increased involvement in the passing attack of late, finishing with four or more receptions in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of many pass-catching options that have flashed impactful ability for head coach Ben Johnson, with a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.
items.title: Luther Burden III leads pass-catchers in Week 6 win over Falcons

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Rome Odunze caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a sizeable impact in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 50 receiving yards in four of the last five contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust for fantasy managers in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.
items.title: Rome Odunze quiet in Week 6 win over Falcons

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Colston Loveland hauled in six of his seven targets for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Loveland has made the most of increased opportunities in the Chicago passing attack of late, recording four or more receptions in three of the last four contests. The tight end will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.
items.title: Colston Loveland finds end zone in Week 6 win

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Roschon Johnson carried the ball 13 times for a team-high 51 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 34 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Johnson made the most of increased touches in the Chicago offense, finishing with over 40 offensive yards for the first time this season. The running back remains more of a handcuff option as part of a Chicago backfield led by D'Andre Swift and missing Kyle Monangai, with a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.
items.title: Roschon Johnson leads backfield in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Patriots D/ST allowed 252 passing yards, 97 rushing yards, and 19 points in a win over the Jets.
items.impact: The Patriots' defense tallied three sacks and forced the first interception of the season for Geno Smith. The Patriots' defense will take on a high-powered Bears' offense in Week 7.
items.title: Patriots D/ST solid in Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Andy Borregales connected on 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 2-of-3 extra point attempts in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Borregales missed his first extra point of the season, but connected on field goals from 27 and 32 yards out to help pace the Patriots to their fourth win of the year. Borregales and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.
items.title: Andy Borregales makes two field goals in Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Hunter Henry caught 4-of-5 targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Henry has found the endzone in two consecutive games and logged at least four targets or more in four of his last five games. Henry remains a trustworthy option heading into a Week 7 matchup with the Bears.
items.title: Hunter Henry hits pay dirt in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: DeMario Douglas caught 7-of-8 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Douglas led the team in receptions and receiving yards and found the end zone for the second straight game. If Rome Doubs (shoulder) is forced to miss any time, Douglas will likely see an increase in playing time. The Patriots take on the Bears Thursday.
items.title: DeMario Douglas finds the end zone in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Romeo Doubs caught his lone target for a 42-yard touchdown in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Doubs suffered the injury on the touchdown catch in which he landed hard diving for the ball. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of a Thursday night matchup with the Bears.
items.title: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) finds the end zone in Week 6

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Kalif Raymond caught both of his targets for 18 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Raymond has fallen back to earth after a scorching start to the season, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in each of the last three contests. The wideout remains one of the more streaky pass-catching options in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.
items.title: Kalif Raymond quiet in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: A.J. Brown caught 3-of-10 targets for 27 yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Brown struggled with drops Sunday, logging three drops in his return to action after a Week 1 ankle injury. Brown and the Patriots play on Thursday, so it is a quick turnaround for the veteran to knock off any additional rust heading into Week 7.
items.title: A.J. Brown hauls in three passes in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson rushed for 31 yards on seven carries in the 26-19 win over the Jets. He caught his lone target for nine yards.
items.impact: Henderson returned from a high-ankle sprain that he suffered last week, but saw Corey Kiner run the ball more Sunday. Henderson did fumble the ball to the Jets, which likely impacted his playing time late in the game. Henderson and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson logs eight touches in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Rhamondre Stevenson rushed for 36 yards on 14 carries in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
items.impact: Stevenson was not involved in the passing game and logged just 2.6 yards per carry on the day. The Patriots gave a total of 18 carries to Corey Kiner and TreVeyon Henderson, limiting Stevenson's chances against the Jets. Stevenson and the Patriots will take on the Bears next week.
items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson quiet in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 18-of-32 passes for 235 yards and three touchdowns in a 26-19 win over the Jets. Maye added 24 rushing yards on four carries.
items.impact: Maye found DeMario Douglas, Hunter Henry, and Romeo Doubs for his three touchdown passes. Maye turned another spotless performance, logging two straight games without a turnover after throwing seven seven interceptions in the first four games. Maye and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.
items.title: Drake Maye tosses three touchdowns in Week 6 win

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: The Jets D/ST allowed 235 passing yards, 148 rushing yards, and 26 points in a loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: The Jets' defense failed to record a sack or interception in the game, but did recover two fumbles in the loss. The Jets' defense are a solid streaming option in Week 7 against Miami.
items.title: Jets D/ST allows 26 points in Week 6 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Jason Sanders made 4-of-4 field goals and 1-of-1 extra points in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Sanders connected on field goals from 36, 36, 40, and 42 yards out to help pace the Jets in Sunday's loss. Sanders has missed just one kick this season so far. Sanders and the Jets will take on the Dolphins in Week 7.
items.title: Jason Sanders perfect in Week 6 loss

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Zavion Thomas caught all three of his targets for 25 yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: Thomas has been a non-factor in the Chicago offense to this point, finishing with less than 30 receiving yards in each of the first six contests. The pass-catcher remains best left out of lineups in all formats ahead of a Week 7 contest against the New England Patriots.
items.title: Zavion Thomas sees three targets in Week 6

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Mason Taylor caught 4-of-6 targets for 33 yards in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Taylor led the tight end group in receptions, yards, and targets. Taylor and Kenyon Sadiq should be expected to continue to split time heading into Week 7.
items.title: Mason Taylor hauls in four passes in Week 6 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 6-of-7 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Cooper led the team in all receiving categories in the loss Sunday. Cooper had been out of action for the last four games with a high-ankle sprain. Cooper will look to continue to build rapport with QB Geno Smith in Week 7 against Miami.
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 6 loss

items.author: Jesse Garcia
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
items.impact: Sadiq returned from a concussion that he suffered in Week 5, but was not a featured part of the offense. Mason Taylor saw six targets to Sadiq's three, so both appear to be involved in the offense heading into Week 7.
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq records one reception in Week 6

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: Cole Kmet caught both of his targets for three yards in the Bears' 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: Kmet has been an afterthought in the offense of late, recording less than 15 receiving yards in each of the last five contests. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats until further notice, with a Week 7 contest against the New England Patriots up next.
items.title: Cole Kmet catches two passes in Week 6

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.desc: The Bears D/ST recorded five sacks while also forcing three turnovers (three fumble recoveries) in a 31-23 win over the Atlanta Falcons in Week 6.
items.impact: The defense was able to keep the Atlanta offense mostly in check, allowing 257 offensive yards in the win. The unit will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.
items.title: Bears D/ST records five sacks in Week 6
